name: 署名済みなら、安全？
shortDescription: npm provenance が保証する範囲を見極め、lockfile・tarball inventory・lifecycle script policy で防御しよう。
description: 上流 registry の乗っ取りで、provenance 付きの改ざん版が正規の publish pipeline から公開された。starter の CI triage policy は valid な attestation を安全と同一視し、manifest の semver range で版を判断し、install script を全許可し、取得と実行を区別せず credential rotation を乱発する。Browser Workbench で合成 fixture (manifest、lockfile、attestation、tarball inventory、host evidence) を観察し、triage policy を修正する。実 package、悪性 code、credential、外向き network は使わない。
instructions: ローカル runtime を起動して Browser Workbench を開く。fixture (manifest、lockfile、attestation、tarball inventory、host evidence) と starter の盲点を観察し、triage policy を修正する。公開 test を通して提出値を作り、同じ値を 6 つの checkpoint へ提出する。hidden matrix は依存 graph を並べ替え、無関係な script を足し、clean な package を混ぜて再評価する。
writeup:
## 境界

npm provenance attestation は「どの source repository の、どの workflow が、この artifact を build して publish したか」を束縛する。subject は artifact digest、predicate は build の出自であり、source そのものが無害であることはどこにも含まれない。maintainer の token が奪われ正規 pipeline から悪性 commit が publish されると、attestation は valid なまま悪性 artifact に付く。

## 判定の分離

resolved version は manifest の semver range ではなく lockfile の exact version + integrity + dependency path で追跡する。tarball の file inventory と install lifecycle event (preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare) の追加は、attestation の valid とは独立に検査する。install script は default-deny にし、必要な package だけを exact version で許可する。incident response は「取得した」「script 無効で install した」「script が実行された」を別状態として扱い、実行 evidence が無い host に credential rotation を宣言しない。
learningGoals: provenance attestation が束縛する対象と保証しない範囲を区別できる
manifest の semver range ではなく lockfile の解決結果で inventory を追跡できる
install lifecycle script を default-deny にし、必要な package だけを exact version で許可できる
取得・script 無効・script 実行済みを区別し、過剰でも過小でもない対応を選べる

en.name: Signed Does Not Mean Safe
en.shortDescription: Learn what npm provenance actually guarantees, then defend with the lockfile, the tarball inventory, and a lifecycle-script policy.
en.description: Upstream registry namespaces were taken over, and tampered releases shipped through the legitimate publish pipeline with valid provenance. The starter CI triage policy equates a valid attestation with safety, resolves versions from the manifest's semver range, allows every install script, and rotates credentials without distinguishing fetch from execution. Observe the synthetic fixtures (manifest, lockfile, attestation, tarball inventory, host evidence) in the Browser Workbench and repair the triage policy. No real packages, no malicious code, no credentials, and no outbound network are used.
en.instructions: Start the local runtime and open Browser Workbench. Observe the fixtures (manifest, lockfile, attestation, tarball inventory, host evidence) and the starter's blind spots, repair the triage policy, pass the public cases to prepare a submission value, and submit the same value to all six checkpoints. The hidden matrix re-evaluates with a shuffled dependency graph, irrelevant extra scripts, and a clean package mixed in.
en.writeup:
## Boundary

An npm provenance attestation binds which source repository and which workflow built and published this artifact. The subject is the artifact digest and the predicate is the build's origin; nothing in it says the source itself is harmless. When a maintainer token is stolen and a malicious commit ships through the legitimate pipeline, the attestation stays valid on the malicious artifact.

## Separate decisions

Track the resolved version from the lockfile's exact version, integrity, and dependency path, never from the manifest's semver range. Inspect the tarball file inventory and added install lifecycle events (preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare) independently of attestation validity. Default-deny install scripts and allow only the packages that need them, pinned to exact versions. For incident response, treat fetched, installed-with-scripts-disabled, and scripts-executed as separate states, and never declare credential rotation for a host without execution evidence.
learningGoals: Distinguish what a provenance attestation binds from what it does not guarantee
Track the inventory from the lockfile resolution instead of the manifest's semver range
Default-deny install lifecycle scripts and allow only needed packages at exact versions
Separate fetched, scripts-disabled, and scripts-executed states and respond without over- or under-reach
